params.name: text
params.description: Free-form text to geocode (addresses, place names, etc.)

params.name: size
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 40)

params.name: lang
params.description: BCP47 language tag for preferred response language (e.g. en, fr, de). Not all places have translated names.

params.name: focus.point.lat
params.description: Latitude of the focus point to boost nearby results

params.name: focus.point.lon
params.description: Longitude of the focus point to boost nearby results

params.name: boundary.rect.min_lon
params.description: Minimum longitude of rectangular boundary (western edge)

params.name: boundary.rect.max_lon
params.description: Maximum longitude of rectangular boundary (eastern edge)

params.name: boundary.rect.min_lat
params.description: Minimum latitude of rectangular boundary (southern edge)

params.name: boundary.rect.max_lat
params.description: Maximum latitude of rectangular boundary (northern edge)

params.name: boundary.circle.lat
params.description: Latitude of the center of a circular boundary

params.name: boundary.circle.lon
params.description: Longitude of the center of a circular boundary

params.name: boundary.circle.radius
params.description: Radius in km of the circular boundary

params.name: boundary.country
params.description: Comma-separated list of ISO-3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country codes to restrict results

params.name: boundary.gid
params.description: Pelias gid of an administrative area to restrict results within

params.name: sources
params.description: Comma-separated list of data sources to query. Valid values: openstreetmap (osm), openaddresses (oa), whosonfirst (wof), geonames (gn)

params.name: layers
params.description: Comma-separated list of layer types to restrict results. Valid values: venue, address, street, neighbourhood, borough, localadmin, locality, county, macrocounty, region, macroregion, country, coarse, postalcode

items.docs: Returns real-time geocoding suggestions as the user types. Best used with client-side throttling (5–10 requests per second). Results include GeoJSON features ranked by relevance and optional geographic focus.
